description_en: Adds one or more devices to a test device group by cloud device ID
description_zh: 通过云设备ID批量添加一个或多个设备到测试设备分组中
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc add-version-group-devices --device-id-type sn --project-id P0VFCREU --device-ids b8fe2e24ff2b48e0a3aa4e49809fc1b3_,_b8f12e24ff2b48e0a3aa4e49809fc1b3 --device-group-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddVersionGroupDevices

parameters.description_en:
The device ID type. Valid values:

- **device_id**: hardware ID
- **sn**: serial number
- **vin**: vehicle identification number
- **hardware_id**: hardware ID.
